subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active-wake inputProvenance be exposed through the public AgentSession.steer/plugin SDK surface, or should this PR keep the provenance plumbing internal to the active wake path?
rationale: The bug fix is narrow, but the PR raises the plugin SDK public export budget and changes a public steering call shape, which is an API contract decision automation should not infer.

options.title: Keep provenance internal
options.body: Resolve the conflict by threading provenance through the internal active-wake queue path while avoiding a new public SDK type unless a public caller needs it.

options.title: Accept the public steer option
options.body: Merge an additive public AgentSession.steer options contract after maintainers confirm plugin authors may intentionally pass inputProvenance.

options.title: Pause for broader session-state design
options.body: Hold this PR until the related subagent wake and sessions_yield routing work defines one canonical provenance contract.

recommendation.title: Keep provenance internal
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflict by threading provenance through the internal active-wake queue path while avoiding a new public SDK type unless a public caller needs it.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent history on the active parent wake/subagent completion files and is listed for Agents in CONTRIBUTING.md.
